response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, technically strong software craftsman with substantial developer-tools and testing-infrastructure experience (custom test runners, CI/CD setup, assertion libraries, GitLab administration) that aligns well with the 'Engineering Productivity' focus. However, his career has been almost entirely as an individual contributor (Staff/Senior Developer titles throughout); there is no evidence of formal people management, direct reports, performance reviews, or team leadership responsibilities, which are explicit minimum requirements for this role. Mobile platform experience is also thin and dated.
strengths: Deep hands-on experience building developer tools, test frameworks, and CI/CD infrastructure (Trial, Fluent-Asserts, GitLab/CI setup)
Broad technical range across languages and systems (D, TypeScript, C/C++, Java) with strong system design and craftsmanship practices (TDD, CD, trunk-based dev)
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing via workshops, dojos, and courses, showing some leadership and teaching aptitude
concerns: No evidence of formal people management experience (no direct reports, no mention of 1:1s, performance management, or hiring)
Career trajectory is consistently IC-focused (Staff/Senior Developer) with no manager or team-lead titles
Mobile platform experience is minimal and outdated (brief iOS/Apple TV work ~2015-2016), not aligned with 'large mobile platform ecosystem' focus

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tools & testing infrastructure background
